indicator_evidence_stack.source: Anchored VWAP visible on chart (entity roOcL6). Anchor was verified via ui_evaluate inspection of the study inputs: start_time=0, source=hlc3, bands_multiplier=1 and 2. As a lifetime cost-basis proxy, 2.37 represents the blended VWAP-weighted average price of all SUI buyers since listing — informative but NOT the strict-Wyckoff markdown-campaign anchor (which would be anchored at the Jan 2025 ATH 5.37 or the Oct 2025 markdown high 4.30). Price sitting on the -1σ band at 1.20 is still a meaningful mean-reversion location.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: Lifetime VWAP at 2.37 is a plausible mean-reversion magnet but should NOT be treated as the trapped-distribution cost basis from the 5.37 ATH; confidence on it as T2 is reduced from high to medium. A campaign-anchored AVWAP from the Jan 2025 ATH was not added and is in missing_evidence.

indicator_evidence_stack.findings: SUI/BTC made a clean descending wedge accumulation with terminal shakedown to 0.0000116 ratio on May 1 (lower low while SUIUSD held above the Feb 5 SC). The May 6 ratio surge to 0.0000174 (+50% in 3 days) coincided with the spot SOS day. Currently at 0.0000151 — well above the spring ratio low. This is a textbook ratio-Wyckoff accumulation pattern that confirms institutional sponsorship.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: Strongest single piece of evidence supporting the long thesis: smart money was absorbing SUI vs BTC into ratio weakness then revealed itself with the SOS surge.
